repositories.name: focusflow
repositories.description: 🎬 Turn complex architecture diagrams into 60fps cinematic interactive stories. Interactive camera paths, AI voiceovers, and standalone single-file HTML or MP4 export.

paragraphs: Turn complex architecture diagrams into 60fps cinematic interactive stories.
When presenting distributed systems, microservices, or complex AI pipelines, static architecture diagrams have fundamental flaws:
FocusFlow bridges this gap. It lets you direct your architecture diagram like a movie camera:
features: Cognitive Overload: A static 4K diagram with 100+ microservices and crisscrossing lines overwhelms the audience within 30 seconds.
Slides vs. Videos Dilemma: Slide decks fragment the architectural topology into disjointed screenshots; screen recordings cannot be paused to inspect or zoom into specific service configs.
Prohibitive Animation Costs: Crafting smooth motion graphics requires days of manual keyframing in After Effects.
Smoothly pans, zooms, and rotates across nodes at 60fps GPU acceleration.
Lights up dynamic cubic Bezier curves between dependencies.

repositories.name: judgment-transfer
repositories.description: Judgment Transfer by SOLIFAN — reviewed expert rules, evidence-checked decisions, and inspectable execution receipts on Google Cloud.

paragraphs: Use the task owner’s materials and explanations. Check which parts of the work AI can handle.

Judgment Transfer identifies missing information and decisions that need a person. Test the instructions, add the task owner’s explanation, and compare what changes. The findings also help improve the handover to the next task owner.

AI proposes and interprets. After the task owner approves the conditions, the application’s shared rule engine applies them to confirmed cases. Application checks validate source references, require approval before guidance becomes active, and control which declared state changes can execute. Unknown or conflicting required conditions keep a case on hold. Workflow fields, actions and conditions are declarations shared by the same core across business domains.
